findings.suggested_fix: Translate the phrase with a more natural Norwegian rendering of “going forth,” e.g. “Jeg hilser Din utferd;” or “Jeg hilser Din utferd/utgang” to avoid the slightly odd noun “utgang.” Preserve capitalization of divine pronouns as in the rest of the poem (see other fixes).

findings.source_quote:
Creator Spirit, work in me
These wonders sweet of Thine;
findings.suggested_fix:
Capitalize the divine pronoun for consistency with earlier lines addressing God (e.g. change “dine” to “Dine”): “Skaperens Ånd, arbeid i meg
Disse Dine søte undere;”
findings.translation_quote:
Skaperens Ånd, arbeid i meg
Disse dine søte undere;

findings.suggested_fix: Remove the comma and smooth word order for Norwegian naturalness while preserving meaning, e.g. “Disse mer guddommelige nyfødte fødsler:” or better “Disse mer guddommelige nyfødsler:”
